I always look at Fed decision days this way. Day one is the overreaction. Day two is the reaction to day one. And day three is when you find out what the real next trends are going to be. This week makes it extra tricky because you have triple witching tomorrow and that is only going to accelerate what day three looks like. Buckle up.
